title: 1963 AHSME Problem 18
statement: Chord \(EF\) is the perpendicular bisector of chord \(BC,\) intersecting it in \(M.\) Between \(B\) and \(M\) point \(U\) is taken, and \(EU\) extended meets the circle in \(A.\) Then, for any selection of \(U,\) as described, triangle \(EUM\) is similar to triangle:

solutions.text:
Since \(EF\) is a diameter, \(\angle EAF=90^\circ.\) Also \(EF\perp BC,\) so \(\angle EMU=90^\circ.\) Because \(E,U,A\) are collinear, the two triangles share the same acute angle at \(E.\) Hence \(\triangle EUM\sim\triangle EFA.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is A.
hints: Because the perpendicular bisector of a chord passes through the center, \(EF\) is a diameter
Compare the right angles and the shared angle at \(E\)
